[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.15.0 - Toulouse[/b][/size]

Toulouse is the sacked town the titans are camped in, and it turned out to need repair more than
restoration.

Two checker flags the act reads and never sets: one of them cost the Speech bluff at the prisoner
pen, and the other -- activated by Lethos under a name one word different from the flag that
exists -- cost everything the prisoners can tell you about the fugitive the titans came for. The
guard's own mercury bribe carried its specification in a designer note and shipped checking for
wine instead, so its success text was the act's last unreachable reply. The warning he was
written to give before he attacks was fired by nothing. Menoetius' generator named him Rhea, so
the relay that empties Toulouse at the end and the alarm that turns the tribe on an attacker both
missed him. And all three endings send word to Montaillou that the titans have gone, to a part
that does not exist on that map, so the village never learned.

Then the act learns to read you. The Daeva that feeds on souls is discussed with somebody
carrying one; Rhea's history of humans binding spirits is answered by the binding, differently
for each of the three; her eater of memories meets a necromancer; Utnapishtim is called the first
Inquisitor by an Inquisitor; and Tereo, who must earn his name, meets a player who has earned
one. Ephebos, the tribe's child, had one line and no replies and now has a conversation. So do
the man, the woman and the child in the pen -- the child's description was written and placed
nowhere at all. And the ogres sell for a skin of wine what fifteen days of mutton bought nobody.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. The new level parts need a character who has not entered
those maps. Unplayed -- what you find goes into 0.15.1.
